name: Set Program Member Status
summary: Sets the program status for leads — and ADDS them to the program if they're not members yet. A 'Change Program Status' activity is logged for each.
whenToUse: The main call for enrolling people in a program and/or moving them to a status (Member, Influenced, Completed, …). Up to 300 leads per call.

body.hint: Lead IDs to create/update in the program — comma-separated.

fields.name: statusName
fields.label: Status to set
fields.hint: Must be a status that exists on this program (defined by its channel) — e.g. Member, Influenced, Completed. Check the program's settings in the Marketo UI if unsure.

response.description: Per lead: created, updated, or skipped (with a reason — e.g. already at a higher status step).

notes: Leads not in the program are ADDED as new members; leads already in it get their status updated.
If a lead's current status is a further step along the channel than the one you set, that lead is skipped (reason code 1037) — statuses don't move backwards.
